program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 6)
                  (nines (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (= (at g r c) 9))
                           (list r c)))
                  (sevens (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)) #:when (= (at g r c) 7))
                            (list r c)))
                  (r9a (min-of first nines))
                  (r9b (max-of first nines))
                  (c9a (min-of second nines))
                  (c9b (max-of second nines))
                  (r7a (min-of first sevens))
                  (r7b (max-of first sevens))
                  (c7a (min-of second sevens))
                  (c7b (max-of second sevens))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((pos nines)) (hash-set! result pos 7))
             (for ((pos sevens)) (hash-set! result pos bg))
             (if (= c9a c7a)
                 (for ((r (range (+ 1 (min r9b r7b)) (max r9a r7a))))
                   (when
                     (for/or ((cc (range 0 w))) (zero? (at g r cc)))
                     (for ((cc (range c9a (+ c9b 1))))
                       (when (= (at g r cc) bg) (hash-set! result (list r cc) 2)))))
                 (for ((cc (range (+ 1 (min c9b c7b)) (max c9a c7a))))
                   (when
                     (for/or ((r (range 0 h))) (zero? (at g r cc)))
                     (for ((r (range r9a (+ r9b 1))))
                       (when (= (at g r cc) bg) (hash-set! result (list r cc) 2))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) bg))))))
